angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 666,689 km at 114.68 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.7201 +/- 0.0132 mas (same row, RUWE 1.17): 114.68 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.9583 +/- 0.0166 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1288 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 666,689 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.9552 +/- 0.0319 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1288 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5388 +/- 68 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1288 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1288 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1288.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.455, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1288 (pscomppars): spectral type G V, from Knudstrup et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.5637K/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1288: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1288 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.257 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1288 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.1549, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1288 (pscomppars): age 6.5 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
